name: Questions Deck
author: Ryan Mcfarlane

sections.description:
Questions Deck started as a tool for therapists. Built originally to help couples therapists give their clients a structured, gentle way to explore their relationship between sessions, it quickly became clear that the same format works beautifully in a much wider range of settings.

Whether you are a therapist, coach, educator, HR professional, or community organiser, Questions Deck gives you a simple way to create a thoughtful, engaging conversation experience directly on your WordPress site.

How it works

Add the shortcode [qdeck_connection_deck] to any page. Visitors choose a level, tap the cover card to begin, and move through your questions one at a time. Cards can be swiped on mobile, clicked through on desktop, or navigated with the keyboard. Questions shuffle on each visit so returning users always get a fresh experience.

Built for therapists and counsellors

The plugin was designed in collaboration with Liminal Therapy, a therapy practice based in Cornwall. The default content reflects a couples therapy context, with three levels of questions designed to help partners explore their history, understand each other more deeply, and build a stronger emotional connection. Tip cards allow therapists to place short reflective prompts between questions, guiding clients through moments where strong feelings might arise.

Useful far beyond therapy

The level and question structure is fully flexible. People use Questions Deck for:

  • Couples therapy — give clients structured conversation prompts to use at home between sessions
  • Team building — help colleagues connect beyond the surface in workshops or onboarding sessions
  • Education — spark discussion in classrooms, seminars, or student wellbeing programmes
  • Coaching — guide clients through reflective exercises between appointments
  • Community groups — facilitate meaningful conversation in faith groups, peer support circles, or social clubs
  • Events and social occasions — create a memorable shared experience at dinners, retreats, or gatherings

Features

  • Clean, elegant card interface with smooth swipe and tap navigation
  • Customisable levels or categories, each with its own tab colour
  • Tip cards — a distinct card type for reflective prompts or guidance, placed manually in the sequence
  • Upload your own logo or set a custom title for the cover card
  • Style options — set a primary and secondary colour; all shades are generated automatically
  • Typography options — system serif, theme font, or paste in any CSS font-family value
  • Shuffle on or off — present questions in a fixed order or randomise each visit
  • Admin preview — see the live deck without leaving WordPress
  • Drag and drop question ordering
  • Fully responsive — works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • All content editable in the WordPress admin with no coding required

Shortcode

[qdeck_connection_deck]

Place this on any page or post.

Photo Credits

sections.installation:
1. Upload the liminal-connection-deck folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Create or edit a page and add the shortcode [qdeck_connection_deck].
  4. Visit Questions Deck > Settings to upload a logo, set colours, and choose your typography.
  5. Visit Questions Deck > Questions & Levels to edit the default questions, add your own, create new levels, and place tip cards.
sections.faq:
Can I edit the questions?

Yes. Go to Questions Deck > Questions & Levels. Click into any question to edit it directly, add new ones at the bottom of each level, or delete with the ✕ button. Hit Save All Questions when done.

Can I create my own levels?

Yes. In the Levels panel, add a new level with a name, subtitle, and tab colour. Questions and tip cards can then be added to that level. Levels can be renamed or deleted — questions in a deleted level move automatically to the first remaining level.

What are Tip cards?

Tip cards are a distinct card type you place manually within any level using drag and drop. They display with a warm background and an “A thought…” label, offering a reflective moment or piece of guidance between questions. They do not count towards the progress indicator shown to users.

Can I change the colours?

Yes. Go to Questions Deck > Settings > Style Options. Set a primary and secondary colour using the colour pickers — all palette shades are derived automatically from those two values.

Can I use my own font?

Yes. Go to Questions Deck > Settings > Style Options. Choose System serif (Georgia), Theme font (inherits your active theme), or Custom CSS where you paste any valid CSS font-family value directly, such as a CSS variable your theme exposes or any locally loaded font stack.

Can I control whether questions shuffle?

Yes. The shuffle toggle is in Settings > Style Options. When off, questions appear in the exact order you have arranged them via drag and drop.

Will this work on mobile?

Yes. The deck is fully responsive and supports left swipe to advance between cards.

Is this only for couples therapy?

No. The default content reflects a couples context, but all levels, questions, and tip cards are fully editable. The plugin works equally well for team building, education, coaching, community groups, or any setting where structured conversation has value.
